title: Spellforge Sphinx
description: A surreal hairless sphinx cat with multiple red eyes, glasses, a unicorn horn, and a spiked collar sits on a purple block labeled 'SPELLFORGE'. It holds a yellow pencil and writes in a notebook while surrounded by colorful glowing orbs, lotus flowers, mathematical symbols, and swirling paint splashes against a black cosmic background.
prompt: A surreal hairless sphinx cat covered in multiple red eyes, wearing round glasses and a spiked collar with a dripping orange unicorn horn, sits on a purple block inscribed with 'SPELLFORGE' and Japanese characters. The cat holds a yellow pencil, writing in an open notebook filled with symbols, surrounded by glowing mathematical equations, colorful paint splashes, glowing orbs, and purple lotus flowers against a black cosmic background with swirling colorful nebulae.
